subject: Demo follow-up: privacy routing, cloud mapping & questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rodriguez <emma@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Demo follow-up: privacy routing, cloud mapping & questionnaire kickoff

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment from a security/compliance perspective.

Recap from the demo (high level):
- We showed the inference flow for customer requests and how routing/fallbacks work across hosted vs dedicated/private deployments.
- You flagged two key concerns: SOC 2 evidence and exact data residency/path for PHI flows.
- Nimble asked for an initial list of Redwood subprocessors and a kickoff of the vendor security questionnaire.

Actions we committed to:
1) Share our current subprocessor roster and a CSV mapping of which processors touch which data types (attached: rwd-subprocessor-list-v1.csv).
2) Share SOC 2 status and timeline — we have SOC 2 Type I (controls design) completed; Type II (operational effectiveness) is targeted for Q4 2028. Will attach the cert / report with NDA/secure link if needed.
3) Kick off your security questionnaire — I’ve attached a short demo recording and a suggested intake form link below to make the handoff to your security team painless.
4) Clarify data classes returned by our endpoints so you can map them to your PHI/PII controls. Please confirm which endpoints you plan to call in production.

Questions for you / ask of NimbleSecurity:
- Can your security team confirm whether they require a BAA (HIPAA) in addition to SOC 2?
- Can you provide a short list of cloud regions/providers (e.g., AWS us-east-1, GCP europe-west1) you expect data to be stored in or routed through?
- Would Nimble prefer a synchronous 30–45 min technical follow-up with our security/infra lead to walk the processor matrix?

Links & attachments:
- Attachment: 20280725-demo-recording.mp4 (stub)
- Attachment: rwd-subprocessor-list-v1.csv (stub)
- Intake form for questionnaire: https://forms.redwood.com/nimble-sq-intake (suggested)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Proposed next meeting windows (all ET): Thu 7/27 10:00–10:45, Thu 7/27 14:00–14:45, Fri 7/28 11:00–11:45. Pick one and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Lauren (legal) on the BAA template if you confirm it’s required.

—
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Rodriguez <emma@nimblehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, IT Security <it-security@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: privacy routing, cloud mapping & questionnaire kickoff

Thanks Markus — great demo and clear recap. Looping in our security team here (IT Security) so they see the intake items. A few quick answers and an attached partial questionnaire (nimble_partial_sq.pdf) — we started filling the vendor questionnaire during the call and will finish once we have some of your artifacts.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: we currently require either a SOC 2 Type II report or a signed remediation plan + timeline if Type II is not yet available. Nimble’s procurement prefers Type II for production contracts; Type I is ok for early pilots. Per the call: you mentioned Type I is done; please share the Type I report and a Type II target date.
- HIPAA / BAA: Nimble will need a BAA for any integration that processes PHI. Please have your legal team (cc’d Markus’ Lauren) send a BAA template or confirm Redwood’s standard BAA.
- Cloud providers/regions: primary runtime expectation: AWS (us-east-1) for production, GCS for long-term backups (europe-west1 for our EU backups). We also use Azure for some analytics workloads but not for primary inference.
- Data types: we will be sending both PII and limited PHI (summary-level clinical notes). We need assurance on encryption at-rest and in-transit, plus KV cache handling for any persisted context.

Attached: nimble_partial_sq.pdf (we filled the easy sections; security will complete once we receive your SOC 2 and the processor mapping).

For the meeting: Thu 7/27 14:00 ET looks good for our security lead. Please send an invite with the proposed agenda: 1) Processor mapping walk-through, 2) SOC/BAA timeline, 3) Data residency & encryption details.

On Tue, Jul 25, 2028 at 3:02 PM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment from a security/compliance perspective.
> 
> [snip — attachments and links included above]

Best,
Emma Rodriguez
Head of Product, NimbleHealth
emma@nimblehealth.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rodriguez <emma@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Jul 2028 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: privacy routing, cloud mapping & questionnaire kickoff

Perfect — thanks Emma and team. Confirming next steps and what we’ll bring to the 7/27 14:00 ET call:

From Redwood (deliverables before or during the call):
- Updated processor matrix (CSV) with data-type columns populated based on our internal mapping (I attached v1 earlier; we’ll send v2 before the meeting).
- SOC 2 artifacts: we will share the Type I report via secure link; Type II timeline and expected quarter (Q4 2028) will be documented and shared in writing.
- BAA: Lauren will draft and share a standard BAA template and highlight any optional clauses for Nimble’s legal review.
- Technical appendix: short note on KV cache behavior and retention defaults for hosted API + options for dedicated/private deployments.

Questions for your security lead to answer on the call (so we can close the scope quickly):
- Which endpoints will be used for production vs test? (we’ll add these to the mapping so you get per-endpoint data-class visibility)
- Do you require double-encryption or bring-your-own-key for backups stored in EU regions?

Meeting invite: sent (Thu 7/27 14:00–14:45 ET). Agenda attached to the calendar invite and linked here: https://drive.google.com/meeting/7-27-nimble-security-kickoff

If your security lead prefers, we can also add a short pre-read (1 page) summarizing our SOC 2 status and the processor mapping highlights so they can prioritize sections of the questionnaire.

Thanks again — looking forward to the call.

—
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
